outcome: postpartum hemorrhage (defined as a decrease in hematocrit of >=10% or receipt of transfusion within 24 hours after delivery)
cohort: Maternal plasma samples were obtained from 30 postpartum hemorrhage cases and 56 matched controls, selected from a cohort of over 60,000 participants in a single institution's perinatal repository.
finding: The study identified 77 differentially abundant maternal plasma proteins between postpartum hemorrhage cases and controls, with several showing potential as predictive biomarkers for postpartum hemorrhage, especially when combined with predelivery hemoglobin.
